environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate tasks in an isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no internet gateway route). Accessible exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint. The VPC endpoint policy restricts the principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/TerraformExecutionRole only. Subnet route table has local VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16) and pl-63a5400a (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) only — no 0.0.0.0/0 route exists. Security group on the ENI allows inbound only from the VPC endpoint's ENI security group (sg-0abc123def456) on port 8443. DNS resolution within the VPC uses Route 53 Resolver with a forwarding rule that resolves *.internal-provider-api.company.io to 10.0.5.10 (internal NLB) only. Outbound security group on the task ENI permits only 10.0.5.0/24:443 (backend subnet). No public IP assigned to task. VPC flow logs confirm zero non-RFC1918 destination traffic.
